GET /api/public/:slug/projects/:projectI: Optional public project page: name and public summary only, and only when the workspace turned the page on for that project. Rate limited.
GET /p/:slug/account: Public page shell for a dues member's account page (static HTML, no data). Rate limited by IP and workspace.
GET /p/:slug/directory: Public page shell for a workspace's dues member directory (static HTML, no data). Rate limited by IP and workspace.
GET /p/:slug/join: Public page shell for a workspace's membership join form (static HTML, no data). Rate limited by IP and workspace.

GET /p/:slug/projects/:projectId: Public page shell for a project's optional public page (static HTML, no data). Rate limited by IP and workspace.
GET /p/:slug/unsubscribe: Public page shell for the membership email unsubscribe link (static HTML, no data). Rate limited by IP and workspace.

POST /api/public/:slug/lead/documents: Project lead link: uploads a document to the link's one project. Valid scoped link, honeypot, form token, optional challenge; file type and size checked. Rate limited.
POST /api/public/:slug/lead/payment-requ: Project lead link: enters a payment request for the link's one project. Valid scoped link, honeypot, minimum-time form token and optional challenge check; the request still needs staff approval. Rate limited.
POST /api/public/:slug/lead/reports/:rep: Project lead link: sends a quarterly report for the link's one project. Valid scoped link, honeypot, form token, optional challenge; file type and size checked. Rate limited.
POST /api/public/:slug/membership/join: Membership join form: stores a join request held until the email address is confirmed by a single-use link sent to it. Honeypot, minimum-time form token, optional challenge check. Creates no contact or term. Strictly rate limited.
POST /api/public/:slug/membership/join/c: Membership join confirmation: a valid single-use link from the confirmation email creates the contact, or attaches to an existing contact with the same email and fills in a missing phone or address, and a pending term (or queues the request for staff approval). Every use is logged. Rate limited.
POST /api/public/:slug/membership/me/car: Dues member account page: opens the payment provider's hosted page to update the saved card of the signed-in dues member. Scoped session link; every use is logged. Rate limited.
POST /api/public/:slug/membership/me/che: Dues member account page: opens the payment provider's hosted checkout page for the signed-in dues member's own term; card details are entered there, never here. Scoped session link; every use is logged. Rate limited.
POST /api/public/:slug/membership/me/det: Dues member account page: updates the signed-in dues member's own name, phone and address. Scoped session link, honeypot, form token; the change is in the audit log. Rate limited.
POST /api/public/:slug/membership/me/dir: Dues member account page: the signed-in dues member's own directory opt-in (fields and public or private). Scoped session link, honeypot, form token; the change is in the audit log. Rate limited.
POST /api/public/:slug/membership/me/ren: Dues member account page: adds the signed-in dues member's renewal term, unpaid, inside the renewal window. Scoped session link, honeypot, form token. Rate limited.
POST /api/public/:slug/membership/sessio: Dues member sign-in: exchanges a valid single-use sign-in link for a one-hour link scoped to that one dues member. Every use is logged. Rate limited.
POST /api/public/:slug/membership/sign-i: Dues member sign-in: emails a single-use 30-minute link when the address belongs to a dues member; the answer is the same either way and is sent before any email, so neither the reply nor its timing shows who is a dues member. Honeypot, form token, optional challenge. Strictly rate limited.
POST /api/public/:slug/membership/unsubs: Membership email unsubscribe: a valid link scoped to one contact turns off non-essential membership email for that contact. Every use is logged. Rate limited.
POST /api/public/:slug/payments/:provide: Payment provider webhook: accepted only when the signature matches the workspace's stored webhook secret; only the workspace's current test or live account is tried, and an event from the other mode is ignored; each event id is handled once, one at a time, so a replayed or simultaneous event changes nothing. Rate limited.
POST /api/public/email/postmark/webhook: Email provider delivery and open reports for membership messages. Accepted only with the shared token header set on the server; updates delivery and open times by provider message id and returns no data. Rate limited.
POST /api/share/:token/request-code: Public share link: access is the unguessable token plus a one-time emailed code.
POST /api/share/:token/verify: Public share link: access is the unguessable token plus a one-time emailed code.
PUT /api/organizational/orgs/:slug/assis: Changes only the caller's own assistant mode (user-level preference).
